hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it routes token flows through configurable Euler vaults, verifies a custom concentration curve, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard concentrated liquidity mechanics — acting as a self-contained AMM that uses Euler vault balances as its liquidity source.
